title: ASK Claim Evidence Status
description: Canonical truth status for one claim. Authority, lifecycle, operational, verification-level, and benchmark-result states are separate contracts.

lowercase_status.description: Read-only compatibility representation used by existing stored #275/#276 artifacts. Writers normalize to the canonical Title Case status.

lowercase_observation_status.description: Backward-compatible subset for existing #276 provenance claims, which never accepted hypotheses or falsified claims.

legacy_status.description: Closed legacy import vocabulary. These values are not canonical writer output.

trigger_descriptions.explicit_claim_audit: The user explicitly requests a claim/evidence ledger or independent claim audit.
trigger_descriptions.multiple_material_claims: Multiple material claims must be audited independently.
trigger_descriptions.high_stakes_readiness: Merge, release, production, security, reliability, performance, cost, ROI, or externally communicated readiness is evaluated.
trigger_descriptions.cross_artifact_synthesis: Claims synthesize evidence across multiple artifacts or revisions.
trigger_descriptions.stable_claim_ids: A later consumer requires stable claim IDs or missing-evidence closure.
